svg.title: Central limit theorem: averages become approximately normal
svg.desc: Four-panel comparison of Uniform(0,1) input and 6000 simulated sample means for n equal to 2, 10, and 30. Histograms of means are overlaid by the normal approximation, which improves as sample size grows; means concentrate near 0.5.
svg.text: Central limit theorem: averages become approximately normal
Normal approximation (not exact for finite n)
As n increases, sample means become more concentrated around 0.5 and more nearly normal.
